CSS Floats and Clear

float: left with text wrapping
Float Left

This text wraps around the floated element on the right side. The float takes up space on the left and the inline content flows around it naturally. This is the classic float behavior used in print layouts for decades.

float: right with text wrapping
Float Right

This text wraps around the floated element on the left side. The float takes up space on the right and the inline content flows around it naturally, demonstrating the opposite direction.

Image-style float with text
IMG

This paragraph flows around a floated placeholder that represents an image. The text wraps naturally around the floated block, similar to how images are typically floated in articles and blog posts.
